args.body: For NORTHERN-CATALOGUE-PILOT-FIT, reuse any finished verdict. If the official Shopify partner profile commits and fits the existing allowance, check who supplied its claims and whether it gives concrete evidence of catalogue or product-data work and an authorized business contact route. A generic migration category is insufficient. Use the profile as secondary evidence unless the agency authored the relevant passage. If acceptable evidence independently establishes workflow fit and a published route, finish the existing unsent bilingual inquiry. Otherwise close the bounded mission after readback under a valid lease, with the decisive gap and a lesson. No external send.
